name: update-conflict-in-turn
description: Two tasks 30 minutes apart, then an explicit request to move one onto the other's slot. The conflicts preflight refuses the first write; because the USER named the time, the agent must re-call with confirm_conflicts and finish the job inside this turn. What it must never do is end the turn holding an unresolved refusal.

steps.say: Remind me tomorrow at 3pm to see the dentist.
Remind me tomorrow at 3:30pm to call the garage.
Move the dentist appointment to tomorrow at 3:30pm.
